item.title: [LU-20729] ATM: reduce review test sessions
item.description:
To reduce the testing backlog and general cost of testing review patches, several enforced test sessions could be removed:

  • review-dne-part-1,3,6,7,8 for el9.7: There is an equivalent set of sessions for el9.8
  • review-dne-zfs-part-1,2,3,4,6,7 for el9.7 (34..40): Also set of sessions for el9.8
  • review-dne-ipv6 for el9.7: Already a session for el9.8.

colmstea, green, thoughts on this? Together with LU-20723 I think we could easily double the patch testing throughput with minor changes.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
That sounds good to me and is a quick impacting change reducing master reviews sessions by 12.

I have a patch ready to deploy once either of you give the go ahead.
